input: unchanged 124x12 per-side coordinates/features; all original windows; hidden10 mean pooled per record and side
weighting: training: global equal-person record weights; evaluation: people then recordings then sides equal
selection: ordinal/joint: highest inner person-equal exact-band accuracy, then lowest NLL, then earliest epoch/lambda order; regression: lowest raw person MAE then earliest epoch
point_calibration: none; keep joint regression head separate from probability argmax
boundaries: 10 or20 step from0 through160; open tails; never clip GDI100
ordinal_output: learned strictly ordered cutpoints with shared latent score; CORAL-inspired cumulative BCE, not official CORAL reproduction
joint_objective: train-only minmax-scaled record MSE + lambda * mean cumulative BCE + historical kernel L2
initialization: all models start fresh per fit; same CNN seed; no cross-fold pretrained weights
pilot_main_gate: all7 3epoch pilots, finite losses and gradients, identity/metric audits, GPU and CPU64 replay <=1e-4 unchanged
parallel: one Slurm job2GPUs,2processes each bound to1GPU, unique outer task partition and locks; no DDP/batch enlargement
limitations: Repeated development cohort, not protected final validation
Feature pooling and person training weights differ from historical CNN; new regression control isolates objective
No guarantee of improved clinical scores or domain transfer
